description:
Cast Basalt Monolith by paying {3}.
Displacer Kitten triggers, blinking Teferi.
Activate Basalt Monolith's first ability by tapping it, adding {C}{C}{C}.
Activate Teferi's second loyalty ability by removing three loyalty counters from it, returning Basalt Monolith from the battlefield to your hand and drawing a card.
